accordion.chooseWhen: Reveal or collapse sections without changing screens.
features: Single or multiple expansion; controlled/uncontrolled values.
Item-level disabling and animated content; custom trigger/indicator children.
constraints: Root owns expansion; Item owns item context. Trigger, Indicator and Content require the matching Item.
There is no visual variant/tone axis; do not invent one.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

card.chooseWhen: Group related media, copy and actions on a surface.
features: Callable convenience component with header/media/footer slots.
Root, Pressable, Header, Content, Footer and Media composition.
constraints: Parts are child-only presentation; they do not manufacture titles or actions.
Use Card.Pressable for an interactive surface; appearance comes from tokens rather than variant/tone.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

carousel.chooseWhen: Browse a finite horizontal collection with snapping.
features: One child per slide; controlled/uncontrolled index, peeking and navigation.
Adaptive dots/counter pagination and tone-aware controls.
constraints: Finite collection, not an infinite virtualized pager.
Native ScrollView-based; no Gesture Handler or Reanimated setup is required by this package.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

charts.chooseWhen: Show numeric series with interactive native charts.
features: Line, multi-line, bar, multi-bar, pie and multi-pie charts.
Axes, legends, tooltips and gesture-driven selection.
constraints: Give the parent an explicit height; data models differ by chart family.
Series/data colors are independent of shared component tones; inspect exported series types.
setup: ThemeProvider and GestureHandlerRootView.
Install/configure Skia, Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets peers.

checkbox.chooseWhen: Choose independent options or represent a mixed selection.
features: checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange; boolean or indeterminate.
Shared size, filled/outlined/soft variants, tones and disabling.
constraints: Render a visible label beside the control; Checkbox has no children/label API.
Group values and aggregate indeterminate state belong to the application.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

color-picker.chooseWhen: Choose and edit a color inline.
features: Immediate or confirm commit mode; controlled/uncontrolled color.
Spectrum, sliders, preview, channel/hex/alpha inputs, swatches and Apply/Cancel parts.
constraints: Parts require ColorPicker.Root; the convenience component assembles a common layout.
Spectrum and selected color are data, not tone. Inputs inherit root tone; their field variant is independent.
Drag presentation freezes React field snapshots until release; native gesture validation is separate from typechecking.
setup: ThemeProvider and GestureHandlerRootView.
Configure SVG, Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets; no portal/overlay provider is needed.

core.chooseWhen: Reuse state, timing and callback behavior in React.
features: Controlled/uncontrolled state, open state, stable event callbacks and timers.
Hardware Back subscriptions, deep merging and small utility helpers.
constraints: Nonvisual package; do not render hooks or utilities as UI.
useEventCallback intentionally reads the latest handler with stable identity. Timer callback changes preserve countdown; BackHandler uses the current callback without resubscribing.
setup: React; native hooks also require React Native. No ThemeProvider.

data-state.chooseWhen: Coordinate loading, empty, error and content states.
features: DataView coordinates state copy/actions; standalone loading/empty/error views.
Custom loaders, state details and tone-aware icons/actions.
constraints: Supply the state detail props required by DataView; flags are application data.
Custom loading/content components own their layout and may ignore tone.
setup: ThemeProvider; configure Reanimated and Worklets.

datetime.chooseWhen: Pick a date, time, date-time or range.
features: Five convenience pickers; value/defaultValue/onChange.
Draft selection with Apply/Cancel, Clear, quick options, month/year Selects and nested time fields.
constraints: Fields default to outlined/neutral. Trigger appearance stays on the trigger; internal month/year/time fields are always outlined/neutral. Tone accents selections and selected quick tags; actions retain their own hierarchy.
Calendar/range and wheel selection states keep their own state styling. Values are Date/time objects, not arbitrary strings.
setup: ThemeProvider, GestureHandlerRootView and SafeAreaProvider.
PortalProvider with a stable PortalStore and a mounted PortalsHost; configure Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets.

echo.chooseWhen: Send typed events between disconnected React consumers.
features: Shared EchoInstance plus emitter/listener hooks and typed event contracts.
constraints: An event bus is not persistent application state; component subscriptions clean up on unmount.
Inspect EchoEvents before inventing event names or payloads.
setup: React; no visual provider.

endpoint.chooseWhen: Connect an Axios API client to TanStack Query.
features: Query, infinite-query and mutation factories; imperative execute functions.
A shared endpoint factory binds a client.
constraints: Use typed factory definitions rather than inventing URL/data props on visual components.
The application owns authentication, query keys, request types and error UX.
Standard query and mutation functions expose .execute; infinite-query factories return hooks only, without an imperative execute API.
setup: Axios client and TanStack Query QueryClientProvider; install axios and @tanstack/react-query.

flat-list.chooseWhen: Render long virtualized lists with known item layouts.
features: Native FlatList export and initial-scroll positioning hook with an explicit scrollToInitialIndex operation.
constraints: Native FlatList props are authoritative; this package does not manufacture List rows.
Use the initial-scroll helper when row sizes are known; use scroll-view for measured content.
setup: React and React Native. No ThemeProvider is required by this wrapper.

flyout.chooseWhen: Show a top or bottom gesture-dismissable sheet.
features: Callable sheet plus Root/Header/Title/Content/ScrollView/FlatList/KeyboardAwareView/Handle parts; body children render directly.

Controlled open state, transition callbacks, safe-area layout and drag dismissal. Bottom Flyout.ScrollView and Flyout.FlatList transfer downward swipes begun at the scroll top to sheet dragging; swipes begun below the top remain scrolling until release. Explicit contentInset.top is respected; horizontal scrolling and top-sheet content keep native gestures. Flyout.FlatList is a thin native FlatList wrapper preserving item types, list props, virtualization and native refs. Plain ScrollView and custom virtualized lists do not opt into this behavior.
constraints: Child-only parts do not generate header content; the convenience component supplies defaults.

Use Content for static padding, ScrollView for scrolling, FlatList for a virtualized body, or a direct KeyboardAwareView body child to reserve keyboard overlap inside the body. KeyboardAwareView renders one View; it adds no scroll container; animated keyboard padding reflows its content and may grow the sheet up to its normal height cap. Avoidance waits for valid layout measurements. Active avoidance expects numeric padding; percentage padding is preserved while inactive. enabled defaults to true; keyboardOffset defaults to components.flyout.keyboardOffset, sourced from space.xs (8 logical units). The gap follows keyboard animation progress and is absent while closed; keyboardOffset=0 removes it. Root stays attached to its placement edge with no keyboard translation. Body padding can grow the sheet, with header and handle reflowing naturally; the scroll viewport shrinks once the sheet reaches its height cap. Overlap accounts for safe area, placement offset and siblings below the body. Normal body sizing returns when the keyboard closes. Focused-field scrolling belongs to the chosen scroll container. Root renders one backdrop and one sheet; safe-area padding is on the sheet itself. Handle inherits Root placement. Root caps the whole sheet at 70% of window height and tracks resizing without rebuilding its drag gesture. Custom containers own padding and keyboard behavior. Flyout does not itself imply a global registration or portal: choose local Portal or OverlayHost explicitly.
setup: ThemeProvider, GestureHandlerRootView and SafeAreaProvider; Reanimated/Worklets setup. KeyboardAwareView also requires react-native-keyboard-controller native setup and KeyboardProvider above Portal/Overlay hosts.
Local portals additionally need PortalProvider/PortalsHost; registered sheets need OverlayProvider/OverlayHost.

form-field.chooseWhen: Add a label, description and validation to a custom control.
features: Render-prop children receive controlProps and invalid/required flags.
constraints: Spread supplied controlProps into the custom control.
FormField does not own the control value or perform validation; do not duplicate labels already supplied to Input.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

icon.chooseWhen: Render a named SVG glyph with an explicit visual weight.
features: Shared Icon renderer, numeric/shared sizes and color/fill overrides.
Named icon subpaths with bold, duotone, fill, light, regular and thin weights.
constraints: Import glyphs from per-icon subpaths; toolkit does not re-export icon.
Icon variant means glyph weight, not filled/outlined/soft component appearance. Raw icons do not have tone.
setup: ThemeProvider and react-native-svg; use icon-catalog.md for exact entrypoints.

icon-view.chooseWhen: Show an icon on a noninteractive themed surface.
features: Size, filled/outlined/soft variants and shared tones; IconButton-aligned geometry.
constraints: Not pressable: use IconButton when the icon performs an action.
Supply the icon; do not assume children become the glyph.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

features: Input uses native value/onChangeText/defaultValue; password and keyboard props.
Textarea supports character count and bounded auto-grow; shared labels/errors/addons.
constraints: Fields default to medium/outlined/neutral; explicit props select other appearances.
Input onChange is a native event callback; use onChangeText for a string.
Prefix/Suffix components are caller-owned content; PrefixIcon/SuffixIcon use themed addon styling.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

list.chooseWhen: Present rows with leading content, text and trailing actions.
features: Callable items renderer and Root/Item/Pressable/Leading/Content/Trailing parts.
constraints: List does not implement selection state or virtualize a long dataset.
Render arbitrary content into child-only parts; combine with FlatList for scale.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

modal.chooseWhen: Request focused confirmation or show a compact dialog.
features: Callable dialog plus Provider/Root/Header/Title/Description/Content/Footer/Close.
Local open/lifecycle props or global OverlayStore registration.
constraints: Modal.Root and Modal.Close require Modal.Provider; Header/Content/Footer/Title/Description are presentation parts. Use the convenience component to assemble the provider and common structure.
Custom Close content must be supplied; the part does not manufacture an X icon.
setup: ThemeProvider and SafeAreaProvider; configure Reanimated/Worklets.
Use PortalProvider/PortalsHost for local portals or OverlayProvider/OverlayHost for global registration.

overlay.chooseWhen: Register and coordinate an application-wide overlay stack.
features: OverlayStore, Provider/Host and typed registration.
Lifecycle, timing, status, layer and visibility hooks.
constraints: Create stores outside repeated renders or once with lazy state.
OverlayHost renders registered overlays; it is separate from the Portal host.
setup: OverlayProvider with a stable OverlayStore and OverlayHost; visual overlays require their own peers/providers.

pagination.chooseWhen: Navigate numbered pages with a controlled or uncontrolled page.
features: Full/compact/adaptive layout, counts and navigation buttons.
Shared sizes and tone-aware active page styling.
constraints: Pagination changes page state; it does not fetch or slice data.
Read page/pageCount prop names instead of assuming value/items.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

popover.chooseWhen: Anchor contextual actions or a tooltip to a trigger.
features: Popover.Root/Trigger/Content and presentation parts; controlled/uncontrolled open.
Tooltip convenience component, host-relative positioning, and measured spring transitions with retained exits.
constraints: Trigger/Content/Close require the same Popover.Root.
The portal host name must match; touch trigger modes differ from browser hover behavior.
setup: ThemeProvider, SafeAreaProvider, PortalProvider and a matching PortalsHost.
Configure Reanimated/Worklets; see package peers.

portal.chooseWhen: Render local content in a named host elsewhere in the tree.
features: PortalStore, PortalProvider, Portal, PortalHost and PortalsHost.
constraints: Portal name must match a mounted host under the same store.
Do not assume arbitrary React context survives relocation; pass/re-provide context where the component requires it.
setup: PortalProvider with a stable PortalStore and PortalsHost. No ThemeProvider is needed for portal infrastructure.

primitives.chooseWhen: Build layouts, typography, actions and custom field composition.
features: View/Pressable/SafeAreaView, Typography presets, buttons and icon buttons.
Avatar, Badge, Tag, Divider, Spinner and compound Control parts.
constraints: Button/IconButton default to medium/filled/primary; Control.Field defaults to medium/outlined/neutral; Divider tone defaults to default.

Typography is a preset namespace, not shared state. All presets accept View-compatible margin and padding props; explicit style values take precedence. Control parts consume Control.Provider/Field context.
Custom React node content owns its own foreground styling; a string child can use the component text defaults.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

progress.chooseWhen: Show determinate progress or ongoing activity.
features: Linear/circular shapes, determinate values and indeterminate animations.
Shared sizes and primary/secondary/neutral/inverse tones.
constraints: variant means linear/circular geometry, not filled/outlined/soft.
No children/label slot is implied; add labels outside.
setup: ThemeProvider; SVG, Reanimated and Worklets configured.

radio.chooseWhen: Choose one option using application-owned grouping.
features: checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange and shared appearance/disabling.
constraints: There is no RadioGroup API; the application owns exclusivity.
Render a visible label beside the control.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

scroll-view.chooseWhen: Scroll content and reveal an initially selected measured child.
features: Native ScrollView and measured initial-scroll hook.
constraints: No virtualization; use FlatList for large datasets.
Attach the helper refs and layout/content callbacks as documented; it is not scroll-to-index for unknown items.
setup: React and React Native. No ThemeProvider is required by this wrapper.

segmented-control.chooseWhen: Choose one of a few adjacent options.
features: Root owns a value; Item provides a value, text or custom children.
Root size/variant/tone and disabled state propagate to items.
constraints: Items require the same Root; nested roots own independent state.
Controlled mode requires value and forbids defaultValue; uncontrolled mode requires defaultValue. Do not pass both.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

select.chooseWhen: Choose one or multiple primitive values from a list.
features: Select and MultiSelect; controlled/uncontrolled values and disabled options.

Caret defaults, initial-scroll-to-selection, loading and field addons. searchable=true adds case-insensitive label filtering, an outlined/neutral search Input and an empty result message; uncontrolled queries reset on opening. Controlled searchValue/onSearchChange displays supplied options without local filtering; optionsLoading shows flyout progress while keeping search and results interactive. Controlled queries are reset by the caller. Selected labels still require their records in options.
constraints: Options are label/value records with primitive values.
Defaults are outlined/neutral. Tone propagates to options and selected tags.
MultiSelect uses soft tags on filled fields and filled tags on outlined/soft fields; disabled tags are outlined and cannot be removed.
setup: ThemeProvider, GestureHandlerRootView and SafeAreaProvider.
PortalProvider with stable PortalStore and PortalsHost; configure Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets.

skeleton.chooseWhen: Represent the geometry of content while loading.
features: Container, Bone, Text and token-matched component presets including Control, Button, Avatar, Slider and Textarea.
constraints: Presets are placeholders, not disabled interactive components.
Match skeleton geometry to the content and use DataView/LoadingView to choose when to show it.
setup: ThemeProvider; Reanimated and Worklets configured.

slider.chooseWhen: Adjust one numeric value or a numeric range.
features: Slider/RangeSlider; marks, steps, labels and controlled/uncontrolled values.
Gesture callbacks and shared filled/outlined/soft variants and tones.
constraints: Range values and callback payloads differ from single-value sliders; read SliderValue.
Numeric data and custom gradient tracks are distinct from tone; ensure min/max/step form valid bounds.
setup: ThemeProvider and GestureHandlerRootView; Gesture Handler, Reanimated and Worklets configured.

features: Controlled current step with next/previous/goto context and imperative ref.
Separate tabs-style step navigation; tone propagates to steps/navigation.
constraints: Not a form validator or uncontrolled wizard.
Items supply Component functions; the application owns current and onChange.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

storybook.chooseWhen: Author native component examples and discover supported options.
features: Description metadata helpers and shared option constants.
constraints: Authoring package, not a component runtime; stories themselves are not public package exports.
Option arrays are not proof that every component supports every option; use component capability facts.
setup: Install as a development dependency with the Storybook host; native preview uses the host providers.

features: checked/defaultChecked/onCheckedChange; shared variants/tones and disabling.
constraints: Provide adjacent label/help text; Switch does not render label children.
Application owns persistence; the control only emits the next checked state.
setup: ThemeProvider; Reanimated and Worklets configured.

tabs.chooseWhen: Switch between a few related content panels.
features: Flat items API, controlled/uncontrolled value and disabled items.
Clip/scroll overflow; initially selected tab reveal and tone-aware underline.
constraints: Only the active panel is rendered; preserve application state outside unmounted panels if necessary.
Tabs is not a Root/Item compound namespace and has no filled/outlined/soft variant axis.
setup: ThemeProvider; install the owning package peer dependencies.

theme.chooseWhen: Configure shared visual tokens and light/dark schemes.
features: ThemeProvider, theme/token hooks, primitive/component factories and style props.
Theme overrides including token maps; explicit scheme and code font.
constraints: Application chooses scheme; do not assume automatic system following.
Overrides are not a component variant. Use semantic roles; preserve validation/disabled/data colors.
setup: ThemeProvider wraps themed components. Native host must load the configured fonts; default body family is Montserrat.

toast.chooseWhen: Show a transient status message with optional action.
features: Callable Toast with compound title/description/icon/action/close parts.
Overlay registration, timed dismissal with background pause and feedback tones.
constraints: Tone is success/info/warning/error, not primary/neutral/secondary.
Custom compound parts need Toast.Root; store-owned lifetime belongs to the registered overlay.
setup: ThemeProvider, SafeAreaProvider, OverlayProvider and OverlayHost; configure SVG, Reanimated and Worklets.

toolkit.chooseWhen: Consume most library packages through one application import.
features: Re-exports component, infrastructure, core and theme packages.
constraints: Does not re-export icon or Storybook; use their owning packages.
Capability records are owned by individual packages; do not assume all exports share size/variant/tone.
setup: Install toolkit and required peers for the features used; providers are still explicit.

DatePicker.valueContract: Stage a draft in the flyout; Apply commits, Cancel discards. Clear edits the draft.
DatePicker.inheritance: Variant styles the trigger only. Flyout surfaces stay neutral; month/year and time fields always use outlined/neutral; tone accents calendar/wheel selections and selected soft quick-option tags. Nested time fields are outlined/neutral and retain the selection accent in their own flyouts. Apply is filled/primary; Cancel is outlined/primary; Clear uses primary text.

Select.valueContract: Select holds one primitive or empty value; MultiSelect holds an array. Options are {label,value,disabled?}.

MultiSelect.valueContract: Select holds one primitive or empty value; MultiSelect holds an array. Options are {label,value,disabled?}.

Divider.semantics: Separator border-intensity tones include subtle/default/strong; primary is opt-in.

Accordion.Indicator.contentContract: Render supplied children; the part does not invent label/icon content.

Popover.Content.contentContract: Render supplied children; portal Content re-provides its required context.

Control.Value.contentContract: Composition primitive; use Input/Select for assembled default icons and labels.

Control.Placeholder.contentContract: Composition primitive; use Input/Select for assembled default icons and labels.

DataView.mountPolicy: Successful content stays mounted and hidden under the loader while loading without error/empty flags. Error/empty flags remove successful content.
DataView.statePrecedence: Error and empty details can both render if both flags are active; applications should choose flags deliberately.
